description: Naval deck cannon, flat-shaded vertex-colour, matched to the approved V8 steamer palette. Carriage on truck wheels; muzzle toward authoring -Y (outboard) at yaw 0 -- a starboard slot (yawDeg 0) fires outboard starboard, a port slot (yawDeg 180) fires outboard port.
boundsNote: PROVISIONAL: from export-verification.json dimensions_xyz (1.22, 2.1816, 1.2756) centred on X and Z-up from the deck plane, root assumed at the breech end (Cannon_Root, whole-carriage recoil pivot) so the barrel runs -Y to the muzzle. Not independently re-measured from the FBX after import; correct once Unity has imported it (docs/DEV-TOOLS.md import step).

visuals.notes: Copied from art-staging/cannon-astra-v1/cannon.fbx (2026-09-23 kit), no .meta -- Unity generates one on first import (SeaSick/Modular/Configure Mesh Importers, docs/MODULAR-SHIPS.md §8). Resources.Load returns null before that import has happened (e.g. headlessly); ModularShipView already falls back to a grey placeholder box in that case.

physical.notes: NOT AUTHORED. Must not be inferred from mesh size, section length or wheel radius.

equipment.notes: Kit export-verification.json dimensions_xyz exactly: fore-aft (carriage) 1.22, across/outboard (barrel run) 2.1816, height 1.2756. Fore-aft and height fit the existing 1.8 x 1.65 deck-slot clearance; the across dimension does not fit the milestone-1 placeholder clearance (1.55), so the real deck-gun slots were widened to 2.3 u across and CrewPassage_Main narrowed to match (2026-09-25, docs/SHIPYARD-API.md §14) -- both still provisional and free to retune.

massKg.source: ShipLoad's lightest gun weight (a swivel), the same provisional figure the implicit hull-form guns used before this module existed.

crew.source: CannonBattery works each gun with one named hand (CrewRoster.GunCrew); WeightModel.CrewPerGun was 1 for the same reason.
